Settings.formFieldsDescription: Choose which fields appear on the review form and whether they are required. An overall rating is always collected when no extra ratings are configured.
Settings.hint: These settings control the storefront review form. The shop should read Custom Object container "product-reviews", key "settings".
Settings.imageEndpointDescription: R2: https://ACCOUNT_ID.r2.cloudflarestorage.com. GCS: https://storage.googleapis.com. Azure: https://ACCOUNT.blob.core.windows.net. Required for S3-compatible hosts such as MinIO.
Settings.imagePublicBaseUrlDescription: Public URL prefix stored on reviews, without a trailing slash. Example: https://pub-xxxxx.r2.dev or a CloudFront domain.
Settings.imageRegionDescription: AWS region such as eu-west-1. R2 and GCS usually use auto. Azure uses the storage location if needed.
Settings.imageSecretAccessKeyDescription: Leave blank to keep the key that is already stored.
Settings.imageSecretStored: A secret key is already saved.
Settings.imagesHint: The shop uploads review photos to this bucket and stores the public URLs on the review.
Settings.noPermission: You can view these settings but you cannot change them.
Settings.noRatingDimensions: No extra ratings yet. The storefront will only show the overall rating.
Settings.ratingDimensionKeyDescription: Lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens. Example: price
Settings.ratingDimensionsDescription: Add extra scores such as price or quality. Each rating has a key (used when saving) and a label per project language.
Settings.ratingScaleDescription: Maximum score customers can give a product.
